nl: 用 antd 风格做目录管理：查询目录名称；表格展示目录名称、排序；目录是树形结构，默认全部展开；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Catalog management with an Ant Design look: query by catalog name; the table shows catalog name and sort order; catalogs are hierarchical and all nodes start expanded; supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③: 声明式树表（antdv/schema）
